notes: Vantage JNB2 at Brollo Road, Isando, Germiston - explicitly in the City of Ekurhuleni, ~17km from JNB1 (Midrand) and <2km from NAPAfrica. Officially commissioned 12 Jan 2026 (DC Pulse); first building 20MW critical IT load / ~33,000 sqm (355,000 sq ft) two-storey facility with N+1 redundancy, 35MVA substation, power by Municipality of Ekurhuleni (Vantage official). Construction announced Dec 2022. Status updated to operational (was 'construction' in first-round).
